issues: 没有导出时长常量，工作台按 16f 推断，只渲染出开头半秒，轮换与合拢揭晓全部丢失
#050506 近纯黑平铺，暗场没有任何光感与层次
NEW 与特性词同色同亮，轮换期读不出"标签 vs 内容"，合拢时也没有"两半成一句"的变化
36f 合拢滑动全程锐利，缺少速度感；词换是纯硬切，丢了原片 1 帧换行闪
changes: 补 TEXT_COLUMN_CONVERGE_DURATION = 180f（8f 黑场 + 82f 轮换 + 10f 停稳 + 36f 合拢 + 18f 定格 + 小字后 22f 静置），钉死位置与唯一合拢节拍不动
冷色深底竖向渐变 + 中线上方极淡顶光 + 暗角 + soft-light 颗粒；合拢落定后背后柔光微亮
NEW 轮换期改次级灰 #8a8c96，合拢中随进度 smooth 提亮到主色；斜体小字降为三级色
合拢按真实速度加水平运动模糊（两词相向，≤4px，静止为 0）；词换瞬间加回 1 帧提亮 + 微光晕
issuesEn: No exported duration, so the workbench guessed 16f and only half a second rendered; the rotation and the converge reveal were lost
Near-black #050506 flat fill with no light or depth
NEW and the feature word shared the same colour, so there was no 'label vs content' read during rotation and no 'two halves become one phrase' moment
The 36f converge slide stayed razor sharp with no sense of speed, and word swaps were bare hard cuts without the source's one-frame flash
changesEn: Added TEXT_COLUMN_CONVERGE_DURATION = 180f (8f black, 82f rotation, 10f rest, 36f converge, 18f hold, 22f after the sub line); pinned positions and the single converge are untouched
Cool dark vertical gradient, faint top light above centre, vignette and soft-light grain; a soft glow rises behind the line once it locks
NEW is secondary grey #8a8c96 during rotation and smoothly brightens to the main ink as it converges; the italic sub line drops to tertiary grey
Horizontal motion blur from actual slide speed (opposite directions, ≤4px, zero at rest); a one-frame brighten with faint glow restored on each word swap
